description: Leaderboard v2 durable queues, freshness, committed processing, historical operations, shared River scheduling and public HTTP reads. DB gauges are replica-deduplicated; no data is not health.

links.title: Chronicle Prometheus guide
links.tooltip: Dashboard and metric documentation in the Chronicle repository

options.content:
**Database truth vs process events:** pending includes delayed, claimed and retry-backed-off keys; due/claimed/backoff overlap with pending. Do not add state counts. Queue panels require a successful snapshot younger than **$freshness seconds** and deduplicate replicas with **max**, never sum. Missing/stale data stays missing—not zero or green health.

**Filters:** Tenant is a UUID and family selects dirty scopes. Operation panels ignore family. Collection failures, River and HTTP have no tenant/family labels and remain deployment-wide. River queue gauges cover the shared `rankings` queue; execution charts select leaderboard job kinds only. Completed operations still have a last-progress timestamp: **no active-stall or completion-percentage claim**. No direct-source publication counters, WAL/lock metrics, HTTP status codes or tenant-level HTTP attribution exist here.

panels.title: Snapshot health — interpret queues only with fresh collection

panels.description: Per replica; positive timestamps only. Missing/zero before first success is not a fresh observation.

targets.expr: time() - (chronicle_leaderboard_queue_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} > 0)

panels.title: Last successful snapshot age

panels.description: Minimum across replicas exposes any last-attempt failure; missing series remains unknown.

targets.expr: min by (tenant) (chronicle_leaderboard_queue_collection_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"})

panels.title: Collection success — worst selected replica

panels.description: Number of observed replica snapshots with timestamp zero. Missing series is unknown, not zero.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant) (chronicle_leaderboard_queue_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} == bool 0)

panels.title: No successful collection yet

panels.description: Process-local collector outcomes summed across replicas. Includes failed tenant reads and failed tenant listing; tenant/family filters do not apply.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (rate(chronicle_leaderboard_queue_collections_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Collection outcomes / second (deployment)
Durable D1 / D2 queues — max across fresh replicas, not partitions

panels.description: All persisted dirty keys, including delayed, backed-off and leased work. Requires fresh successful snapshots; max across replicas. No data means unknown.

targets.expr: max by (tenant, family) (chronicle_leaderboard_queue_pending{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant", family=~"$family"} and on (job, instance, tenant) ((chronicle_leaderboard_queue_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} > 0) and (time() - chronicle_leaderboard_queue_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} < $freshness) and (chronicle_leaderboard_queue_collection_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} == 1)))

panels.title: Pending dirty keys

panels.description: process_after and retry_after elapsed and no live lease. Requires fresh successful snapshots; max across replicas. No data means unknown.

targets.expr: max by (tenant, family) (chronicle_leaderboard_queue_due{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant", family=~"$family"} and on (job, instance, tenant) ((chronicle_leaderboard_queue_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} > 0) and (time() - chronicle_leaderboard_queue_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} < $freshness) and (chronicle_leaderboard_queue_collection_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} == 1)))

panels.title: Due / claimable keys

panels.description: Unexpired lease; not proof of worker progress. Requires fresh successful snapshots; max across replicas. No data means unknown.

targets.expr: max by (tenant, family) (chronicle_leaderboard_queue_claimed{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant", family=~"$family"} and on (job, instance, tenant) ((chronicle_leaderboard_queue_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} > 0) and (time() - chronicle_leaderboard_queue_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} < $freshness) and (chronicle_leaderboard_queue_collection_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} == 1)))

panels.title: Live leased keys

panels.description: retry_after is in the future, not a cumulative retry-attempt count. Requires fresh successful snapshots; max across replicas. No data means unknown.

targets.expr: max by (tenant, family) (chronicle_leaderboard_queue_retrying{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant", family=~"$family"} and on (job, instance, tenant) ((chronicle_leaderboard_queue_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} > 0) and (time() - chronicle_leaderboard_queue_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} < $freshness) and (chronicle_leaderboard_queue_collection_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} == 1)))

panels.title: Retry backoff keys

panels.description: Age since oldest dirtied_at; repeated mutations can refresh it. Zero timestamps are empty queues and omitted; absent data is not healthy zero.

targets.expr: max by (tenant, family) ((time() - (chronicle_leaderboard_queue_oldest_pending_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant", family=~"$family"} > 0)) and on (job, instance, tenant) ((chronicle_leaderboard_queue_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} > 0) and (time() - chronicle_leaderboard_queue_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} < $freshness) and (chronicle_leaderboard_queue_collection_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} == 1)))

panels.title: Oldest pending age (fresh replicas)

panels.description: Age since oldest process_after among claimable rows; not upload/event age. Max age among fresh replicas is conservative. Empty timestamps omitted.

targets.expr: max by (tenant, family) ((time() - (chronicle_leaderboard_queue_oldest_due_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant", family=~"$family"} > 0)) and on (job, instance, tenant) ((chronicle_leaderboard_queue_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} > 0) and (time() - chronicle_leaderboard_queue_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} < $freshness) and (chronicle_leaderboard_queue_collection_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} == 1)))

panels.title: Oldest due age (fresh replicas)
Processing attempts and committed outcomes — not an accounting ledger

panels.description: Only after transaction commit: committed includes deleting results with no evidence; fenced is a successful no-op rejected by ownership/lease guards. Not rows inserted; process crash can undercount.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant, family, outcome) (rate(chronicle_leaderboard_events_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant", family=~"$family", phase="publish", outcome=~"committed|fenced"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Publication committed / fenced scopes per second

panels.description: Committed retry submissions can be token-fenced no-ops; not affected-row counts. Dispatch nudges are scheduling attempts, not completions.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant, family, phase, outcome) (rate(chronicle_leaderboard_events_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant", family=~"$family", phase=~"retry|dispatch_nudge"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Retry submissions and dispatcher nudges / second

panels.description: Compute/publication/retry durations include failed attempts. Histogram buckets summed across replicas before quantile.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant, family, phase, outcome) (rate(chronicle_leaderboard_phase_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant", family=~"$family"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Phase attempt p95

panels.description: Histogram count measures attempts, unlike committed event counters. Includes failures and is not successful throughput.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant, family, phase, outcome) (rate(chronicle_leaderboard_phase_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant", family=~"$family"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Phase attempt rate by outcome
Latest persisted operation — obligations, not unique runs or completion percentage

panels.description: Gauge resets for new operation; no rate or percentage. Latest persisted operation may be completed. Family filter does not apply; phase can change between replica snapshots.

targets.expr: max by (tenant, phase) (chronicle_leaderboard_operation_obligations{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} and on (job, instance, tenant) ((chronicle_leaderboard_queue_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} > 0) and (time() - chronicle_leaderboard_queue_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} < $freshness) and (chronicle_leaderboard_queue_collection_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} == 1)))

panels.title: Latest operation discovered obligations

panels.description: Latest persisted operation may already be completed. No active-state metric exists; never alert on this age alone. Uses latest positive progress timestamp among fresh replicas.

targets.expr: time() - max by (tenant) ((chronicle_leaderboard_operation_last_progress_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} > 0) and on (job, instance, tenant) ((chronicle_leaderboard_queue_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} > 0) and (time() - chronicle_leaderboard_queue_snapshot_timestamp_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} < $freshness) and (chronicle_leaderboard_queue_collection_success{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant"} == 1)))

panels.title: Latest operation last-progress age (not stall detection)

panels.description: Includes drain-check transactions, not only advancing discovery. No unique-run count or completion percentage. Ignores dirty family filter.

targets.expr: sum by (tenant, phase) (rate(chronicle_leaderboard_events_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant", family="operation", outcome="committed_page"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Committed operation pages / second

panels.description: All phase attempts including failures; source runs are date scoped while evidence/result reconciliation is all-time. No active operation identity or percentage metric.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tenant, phase, outcome) (rate(chronicle_leaderboard_phase_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", tenant=~"$tenant", family="operation"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Operation page attempt p95
River scheduler — shared rankings queue; leaderboard execution kinds only

panels.description: DB-global queue gauge, max across replicas; no kind or tenant label. Includes non-leaderboard rankings jobs; do not sum replica copies.

targets.expr: max by (queue, state) (chronicle_river_queue_jobs{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", queue="rankings"})

panels.title: Shared rankings River queue by state

panels.description: DB-global oldest age by state, max across replicas. Includes other ranking jobs. No tenant/family filter.

targets.expr: max by (queue, state) (chronicle_river_queue_oldest_job_age_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", queue="rankings"})

panels.title: Shared rankings oldest active job age

panels.description: Process-local execution events, summed once by kind/result. No tenant label; queue totals are not multiplied by joining job kinds.

targets.expr: sum by (kind, result) (rate(chronicle_river_jobs_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", queue="rankings", kind=~"leaderboard-(d1-repair|d1-dispatch|d2-drain|d2-dispatch|operation-page|operation-dispatch)"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Leaderboard River outcomes / second

panels.description: Process-local histogram buckets summed across selected replicas; leaderboard kinds only. No tenant/family attribution.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, kind) (rate(chronicle_river_job_queue_wait_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", queue="rankings", kind=~"leaderboard-(d1-repair|d1-dispatch|d2-drain|d2-dispatch|operation-page|operation-dispatch)"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Leaderboard River wait p95

panels.description: Process-local histogram buckets summed across selected replicas; leaderboard kinds only. No tenant/family attribution.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, kind) (rate(chronicle_river_job_run_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", queue="rankings", kind=~"leaderboard-(d1-repair|d1-dispatch|d2-drain|d2-dispatch|operation-page|operation-dispatch)"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Leaderboard River worker p95

panels.description: Process-local histogram buckets summed across selected replicas; leaderboard kinds only. No tenant/family attribution.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, kind) (rate(chronicle_river_job_complete_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", queue="rankings", kind=~"leaderboard-(d1-repair|d1-dispatch|d2-drain|d2-dispatch|operation-page|operation-dispatch)"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Leaderboard River result-persistence p95

panels.description: All River queue collection failures in the deployment, not tenant-specific. Missing counter series is not a verified zero.

targets.expr: sum(rate(chronicle_river_queue_metrics_collection_failures_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: River queue metric collection failures / second
Public leaderboard HTTP — origin requests; no tenant or status-code labels

panels.description: Matched route templates, including maintenance separately; completed origin requests only. No status-code/caller/tenant dimensions; tenant/family filters do not apply.

targets.expr: sum by (path, method) (rate(chronicle_api_requests_processed_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", path=~"/api/v1/leaderboards-v2(/maintenance)?"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Public leaderboard request rate

panels.description: Includes all observed responses; cannot distinguish success/error. Histogram buckets summed across replicas before calculating route/method p95.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, path, method) (rate(chronicle_api_request_latencies_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", path=~"/api/v1/leaderboards-v2(/maintenance)?"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Public leaderboard request latency p95

title: Chronicle Leaderboards
